target.title: fix(auth): use sanitized profile name for Codex import even without id- prefix
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When migrating OpenAI Codex auth credentials, if the credential's identity contains no `accountId`, the system picks a name using `resolveOpenAICodexImportProfileName`.

Previously, the function only accepted `profileName` if it started with the `"id-"` prefix. If it did not (for example, when using email-based profile names like `user@example.com`), it fell back to a hardcoded string parameter (`fallback`, e.g. `"codex-import"`).

This causes profile name collisions when importing/migrating multiple credentials that lack an `accountId` but have distinct `profileName`s.

## Fix

Accept and use the `profileName` even if it does not start with `"id-"`, after sanitizing it to remove illegal characters.

## Test plan

Added a unit test `uses sanitized profileName even when not starting with id- prefix` in `src/plugin-sdk/provider-openai-chatgpt-auth.test.ts`. Verified that all 5 tests passed.


## Evidence
